13-foot-tall, red-skinned devil who wields an iron mace. Represents the dominion of evil via dictatorial might.

AC 21 (+2 plate and +2 shield), HP 105, ATK 4 +3 spear +10 (1d6+3) and baleful beauty, MV double near (fly), S +5, D +4, C +6, I +3, W +4, Ch +6, AL C, LV 22

Impervious. Fire and cold immune. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

Lord of Iron. Command iron golems and other metal creatures. Iron within double near of Dispater does not rust or crumble.

Mortal Gaze. Glare at dying mortal, who instantly dies and rises as a zombie lord.

Voice of Command. As an action, issue a one-word command. All mortals that can hear, CHA 18+ or obey the command for 1d4 rounds.
